dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: There sure are a lot of people here. Do I detect a whiff of some secret, under-the-table dealings... veiled behind the facade of a simple card game? Relax, haha... Just kidding.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: You're off? In that case, I'll come with. I'd better get back to work before the files start piling up.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Whew, finally came out on top. I have to admit, it seems like luck can be a core part of a winning strategy in this game...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Looks like you got the better of me... Man, where was that trump card when I needed it? All that intuition and reasoning, and to no avail... Such a letdown.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Why not? I'm between cases right now, so let's play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Didn't expect the deck I came up with to be this impressive. Would you like to take a look? Maybe we can exchange decks and play another round.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Mm, clearly something wrong with this setup... Aha, I think I know where the problem lies...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Perfect timing! I've been itching to play cards for some time now. No wagers, though — let's keep this friendly. Wouldn't want there to be any sore feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Not as rusty as I thought, huh. If you're up for another round, come back anytime.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Looks like I've gotten rusty, after all. Next time I wrap up a case, I ought to spend some more time polishing my skills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
